identity.name: utils
identity.description: SAO Utils-inspired hybrid fixture combining a host-managed magnet hub, ambient shell surfaces, and a native-style sidecar probe lane.

commands.title: Utils: Probe System
commands.description: Run the sidecar system probe and snapshot visible host capabilities.

commands.title: Utils: Probe Performance
commands.description: Run the sidecar performance probe and persist a coarse CPU, memory, process, and network snapshot.

commands.title: Utils: Probe Windows
commands.description: Run the sidecar shell-window probe against the host-managed desktop bridge.

commands.title: Utils: Probe Qt Adapter
commands.description: Inspect the Qt/QML adapter lane contract without creating a host-visible UI surface.

commands.title: Utils: Play/Pause
commands.description: Toggle PMP playback through the host audio playback capability.

commands.title: Utils: Next Track
commands.description: Request the next PMP queue item through the host audio playback capability.

commands.title: Utils: Previous Track
commands.description: Request the previous PMP queue item through the host audio playback capability.

commands.title: Utils: Toggle Mute
commands.description: Toggle PMP output mute through the host audio playback capability.

commands.title: Utils: Simulate Sidecar Hang
commands.description: Hold runtime activation to validate unresponsive detection and forced teardown.

commands.title: Utils: Simulate Sidecar Crash
commands.description: Emit a fatal runtime error after activation to validate crash cleanup.

pages.title: Utils Page
pages.description: Expanded SAO-inspired detail view for host capability, shell surface, and sidecar diagnostics.

shellSurfaces.title: Utils Overlay
shellSurfaces.description: Quick ambient panel mounted through the host overlay window chain.

shellSurfaces.title: Utils Widget
shellSurfaces.description: Desktop widget surface for HUD-like status and last probe summary.

variants.label: Hub
variants.description: Primary SAO-like dashboard for shell surfaces, host capabilities, and sidecar status.

variants.label: Compact
variants.description: Denser chrome for tighter matrix footprints and HUD-style layouts.
